project.name: Mixed-Material Workshop (Metric)
project.description: Synthetic metric companion to mixed-material-workshop: the same layout in metric sizes, for comparing the ISO-informed material hatching with the NCS-informed one.

exceptions.reason: The office window serves the narrow office; it cannot match or mirror the vehicle opening beside it.
Vehicle opening stays aligned with the shop bay and concrete apron.
Window stays east of the upper bathroom; stacking it over the office window would move it into that bathroom.
The wider picture window serves the open studio beside its smaller window, rather than copying the ground-floor office and vehicle bays.
High north window serves the stair end of the shop and preserves wall space beyond it.
Upper north window stacks over the high stair-side shop window.
West windows stack north of the upper bathroom partition instead of at the full facade centre.
Window stays in the studio, clear of the bathroom partition and its return.

assumptions.statement: This material and structure-display study omits MEP routes and devices. The sinks and toilet show fixture footprints only; plumbing connections, room device coverage, stair headroom, and service clearances remain to be designed.

evidence.note: Synthetic capability study, not a complete workshop residence.

assumptions.statement: No survey, setbacks, soils report, or utility locations are known for this synthetic fixture.

evidence.note: Fixture intentionally excludes survey data.
